 Mr. S.Y. Mahajan, App for respondent
 ...

Coram : Smt. Vibha Kankanwadi, J.
 Date : 21st December, 2020.

Per Court :
1
Heard learned Advocate for the applicant and learned APP for the respondent/State.
2 Perusal of the FIR shows that allegations are made that the accused persons were found transporting the contraband articles.

Therefore,
Section 328 of the Indian penal Code is not prima facie made out.
Other sections are bailable.
For this purpose interim protection deserves to be granted.

3 In this regard, reliance can be placed on the Division Bench decision (Nagpur Bench) in Nilesh Narayan Sanghavi vs. The State of Allah Baksh Shaikh Moulana vs The State Of Maharashtra on 21 December, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83203851/
